Gold and Ganja Seized at Airports, Passengers Apprehended

Authorities have seized contraband, including gold and ganja, at two major Indian airports, leading to arrests. At Mumbai Airport, ganja worth ₹2.38 crore was confiscated, and a passenger bound for Abu Dhabi was arrested. Separately, at Delhi Airport, a Bangladeshi transit passenger was apprehended with ₹1.47 crore worth of gold concealed in a washroom.
